name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
summary: A placement-linked skill development programme for rural poor youth that provides free training in employable trades and guarantees placement in wage employment or self-employment.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must live in a rural area.
The applicant must be 35 years of age or younger.

entitlement_rules.text: Eligible rural youth receive free skill training with a guaranteed placement; there is no direct cash benefit.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the block level.
